name: Egberipiribo
description: A multi-skin publishing theme. Ships Fable: a colour rail with the site's sections, a front page that leads deeper, and stories set for long reading.
author: Krafty Sprouts Media, LLC

home-also-today.label: Front page: also today (three stories beside the cover)

home-long-read.label: Front page: the long read (one story in the brand colour)

home-sections.label: Front page: from the sections (up to four featured lists)

home-most-read.label: Front page: most read (a ranked list)

ad-leaderboard.label: Header banner: ad below the top of every page (728 × 90)

ad-in-feed.label: In-feed banner: ad between rows of stories (970 × 250)

settings.label: All skins: chooses the skin once more than one ships
settings.description: Chooses the skin once more than one ships (strata and threads are added to the options by the update that builds them). Today there is one option, so the setting is not shown. Strata and Threads are listed as options for the structure; only fable exists in this release.

settings.label: All skins: master switch that hides every ad region at once without emptying them
settings.description: Master switch that hides every ad region at once without emptying them. Used by Fable, Strata and Threads. WordPress has no master switch, only the three per-placement switches below.

settings.label: All skins: turns the newsletter band on or off
settings.description: Turns the newsletter band on or off (Strata footer, Threads home band and Subscribe page). WordPress: egberipiribo_newsletter_enabled, default off; the drawings show the band so it defaults on.

settings.label: All skins: prints "Updated <date>" in place of the publish date once a post…
settings.description: Prints "Updated <date>" in place of the publish date once a post was edited well after publishing (WordPress: post_display_date(), always on). Strata and Threads singles.

settings.label: All skins: how long after publishing an edit counts as an update
settings.description: How long after publishing an edit counts as an update (the WordPress rule is a fixed seven days, App\post_display_date()).

settings.label: All skins: shows or hides the comment list and form on posts
settings.description: Shows or hides the comment list and form on posts. Used by Fable, Strata and Threads (WordPress shows them whenever the post allows comments).

settings.label: All skins: "N min read" figure
settings.description: The "N min read" figure (Strata byline and cards, Threads kicker, lead and rows). WordPress always prints it.

settings.label: All skins: tag chips under a post
settings.description: The tag chips under a post. Strata and Threads (WordPress: egberipiribo_strata_tags_enabled and egberipiribo_single_tags_enabled, both default on).

settings.label: All skins: author bio box under a post
settings.description: The author bio box under a post. Strata and Threads (WordPress: egberipiribo_strata_author_box_enabled and egberipiribo_single_author_bio_enabled, both default on).

settings.label: Footer: dark sign-up band above the footer
settings.description: The dark sign-up band above the footer (the drawing has it on every page); off removes the band and the rail and menu buttons that point to it.

settings.label: Search: search overlay opened by the search buttons or "/"
settings.description: The search overlay opened by the search buttons or "/" (the drawing); off makes the buttons plain links to the search page.

settings.label: Search: "/" key hint in the rail search button and the keyboard shortcut…
settings.description: The "/" key hint in the rail search button and the keyboard shortcut itself.
